target.title: fix(auth): preserve auth profile order when copying store to spawned agent
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When copying auth profile credentials to a spawned child agent via `buildPortableAuthProfileSecretsStoreForAgentCopy`, the provider order configurations (`store.order`) were completely omitted. This wiped out any custom provider profile precedence in the spawned child agent's store, forcing it back to arbitrary defaults.

## Fix

Include the `order` configuration property in the copied store object, filtered so that only the copied profile IDs are retained for each provider.

## Test plan

Added unit tests to `src/agents/auth-profiles/portability.test.ts` verifying:
- Precedence order is correctly preserved and filtered to copied profile IDs.
- Order is omitted when the input store has no order.
- Providers are entirely dropped from the order list if all their profile IDs were skipped/excluded.

All tests passed successfully.


## Evidence
